mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nw_model_realtime_sessions WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND operation_id=#{operation}
SELECT * FROM nw_model_realtime_sessions WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_model_realtime_sessions(id,owner_id,tenant_id,operation_id,command_sha256,kind, model_config_id,model_revision,provider_id,service_id,model_id,endpoint,credential_encrypted, provider_task_id,timeout_seconds,sample_rate_hz,language,input_text,voice,status,partial_text, final_text,reason_code,finishing,next_audio_sequence,created_at,updated_at,deadline) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{ownerId},CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint),#{operationId},#{commandSha256},#{kind}, CAST(#{modelConfigId} AS bigint),#{modelRevision},#{providerId},#{serviceId},#{modelId},#{endpoint},#{credentialEncrypted}, #{providerTaskId},#{timeoutSeconds},#{sampleRateHz},#{language},#{inputText},#{voice},#{status},#{partialText}, #{finalText},#{reasonCode},FALSE,0,#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{deadline}) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_model_realtime_sessions SET status='RUNNING',updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE nw_model_realtime_sessions SET partial_text=#{text},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
UPDATE nw_model_realtime_sessions SET finishing=TRUE,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND owner_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND NOT finishing

UPDATE nw_model_realtime_sessions SET status=#{status},final_text=#{finalText},reason_code=#{reasonCode}, provider_task_id=#{providerTaskId}, input_tokens=#{inputTokens},output_tokens=#{outputTokens},characters=#{characters},duration_seconds=#{durationSeconds}, asset_source_encrypted=#{assetSourceEncrypted},asset_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS bigint),updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE nw_model_realtime_sessions SET reason_code='model_realtime_asset_unavailable',updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND NOT asset_available
